name: codex-game-maker
description: A Godot-first commercial game studio workflow covering player-ready production, verified builds, platforms, performance, compliance, localization, marketing, and live operations.

interface.shortDescription: Build and commercially release verified Godot games.
interface.longDescription: Run a Godot-first commercial studio workflow from product thesis through player-ready production and target-platform release. Codex Game Maker covers design, implementation, 2D assets, authored UI, audio, accessibility, localization, narrative, executable quality commands, valid runtime media, performance budgets, builds/signing, compliance, store marketing, online services, telemetry, support, rollback, and strict evidence-backed release gates.
defaultPrompt: Build this game end to end until it passes the player-ready gate; do not stop at a prototype or mock assets.
Prepare this game for commercial release across its declared platforms and keep working until the strict commercial gate passes.
Audit this project honestly across player-ready quality, performance, platforms, compliance, localization, accessibility, marketing, and live operations.
